title: Horizon Equilibrium Network (HEN): a steady-state peer-to-peer ledger framework (v1.0)
description: Research whitepaper and supporting material for a layered, steady-state peer-to-peer ledger framework. Mechanism discussion, toy-model simulation, acceptance test suite, handover pack. A research document only: no token, no issuance, no fundraising, no network, nothing tied to a tradable asset. Whitepaper text frozen at v1.0; hashes and RFC 3161 timestamp recorded in docs/legal/finalization.md.
notes: Author name is a fixed research pen name, not an identity declaration (see AUTHORS.md). No ORCID is given, deliberately: an ORCID identifies a natural person. Zenodo will accept the record without one; DOI minting is unaffected.
